scene_sentence_zh: 苔蘚覆滿的泉池上緣有一座低矮石龕，墨黑的水面映著林隙間垂落的冷光。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a low carved stone niche above a mossy spring basin, still black water brimming to the stone lip, ferns and pale moss covering wet granite blocks, cool morning light through the canopy glinting on the water, a single tarnished bronze cup on the stone rim, open gravel across the lower foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: A painterly JRPG spring shrine: a carved stone niche over a dark still basin ringed by worn sandstone columns and urns, ferns and moss on the wet granite, a small bronze bowl on the rim, an open gravel and stone apron across the lower foreground. No figure, no creature, no readable lettering; the landmark object sits in the upper half with the open pool and apron below.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop: the full-bleed composition holds at 1451x790: the niche and columns keep the upper band while the lower apron stays unobstructed for stage figures, and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed on a ten-up contact sheet of the whole rite pack: each archetype reads as its own place — spring basin, stag statue, stone circle, sea tower, tree hollow, grave rows, crystal mine, sandstone arch, waterfall basin and capital plaza — with a consistent painterly palette and no two compositions alike.
